reason: Full concept review confirms all six approved patches, exact pin hashes, and preserved unrelated sections, but three untouched active statements still misstate or overgeneralize the November guide. The payment-gate exception must remain consistent in the failure section; a replacement update gets a new pending-update expiry only after failure; and the prerequisite list's count and account-eligibility boundary need correction. This is bounded to the candidate and the cited November source lines, not a new full raw audit.
required_changes: At candidate line 25, the November 7 guide's supported-method list has 26 entries (raw lines 34–59), not 27. Correct the count or omit it, date the documentation list, and avoid implying every listed method is enabled for an individual account or customer (accepted source candidate line 30).

At candidate line 56, scope 'On repeated failure ... no changes applied' to a failed retry of the pending invoice, or explicitly subject it to the paused-subscription resumption exception. The unqualified sentence conflicts with candidate lines 10 and 80 and November raw line 28, where a matching pending update may apply despite failed payment after resumption to active or past_due. November raw lines 97–104 describe the ordinary invoice-retry branch.

At candidate line 61, do not say a replacement update always sets a new expiry. November raw line 112 says the old invoice is voided and a new invoice created; successful payment applies the latest values, while payment failure generates the replacement pending_update with a new expiration. Preserve the separate payment/application timing boundary already stated at candidate lines 37–38.
